answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a polynomial whose identity commitment binds their assigned point. Semaphore membership proofs and RLN nullifiers enforce one message per rate-limit window. Duplicate messaging yields two Shamir shares of the same signing secret; interpolation reveals the private key and triggers instantaneous collateral slashing. Domain-separated labels such as karst, copper, and timber prevent cross-context reuse.
